title: 第25章 慕容仙儿出手第26章 就这
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
白色光球带着旋转之力逐渐缓慢，南宫长老脸颊汗水滑落，脸色更是苍白，一身灵力早已耗尽。
八个活死人撑开白色光球没有被大挪移，而后六部众也是撑开灵力之球，在明宣几人焦急的眼神中，巨大的镰刀划破白色灵力之球就欲破开。
南宫长老无奈，灵阵就是消耗太大了，而且对方实力也不低，加上人数众多，只能挪走一些低境界的。
如此只能减轻学院弟子的压力，避免更多的伤亡，这也是没有办法的办法...
就在南宫长老这样想着时候，突然，一只玉手带着无比纯净的白色灵力涌入南宫背后，后者会意，当下催动灵力开始充盈，余下三个挪移阵灵球一并消失。
“不，拦住他！”
沐战大喝，飞身而下朝着南宫背后的慕容仙儿而去。他只知道这个女子就是朝暮山的客卿长老。
但是先前慕容仙儿一直没出手，故沐战也没防范，再者看慕容仙儿年纪如此年轻，想必实力也不怎么样。
可是此刻慕容仙儿突然出手援助南宫，这是沐战没想到的，此关键时刻万万不能让南宫恢复，阵法师的可怕是能左右战局的。
美目转动，少女带着微笑一掌拍出，黑色身影面带惊愕被击飞，眼中尽是不可置信。
但是此刻场中冥府的府兵和沐府的府兵还有诸教的人马皆是伴随着白色灵力之球消失。
“参与试炼之地的青年，考验你们实力的时候到来了，协执法堂斩杀恶敌积分划入功勋简，执法堂弟子不纳入积分榜，现在就看你们的了！”
伴随着挪移阵的消失，明宣也是也是抛起一枚水珠凝成的小世界言道，显然那诸教数千人马除开生死境都被纳入了试炼之地的小世界。
“可恶，坏我好事。”
随着明宣的话语，无论是沐战还是冥府之主都是一脸肃杀之气看着慕容仙儿。
“你回内院，不要出来！”
左丘辰耳边传来那道冰冷的声音，如以往不同，此次慕容仙儿的声音多了一缕冷意与杀气。
那白裙飘动然后跃身而起的景象浮现，左丘辰被惊醒，然后木讷的跑到内院，藏在海棠窗的院墙之下。
战场在这瞬间停止了，北安城外被黑气侵蚀枯萎的草地，冥府一方黑色雪花坠落，偌大的广场满目疮痍，外院无数建筑摧毁，包括内院也是受到波及。
蓝色大阵升起，那是来自北宣学院的护院大阵，不到万不得已，不到生死存亡时刻，这蓝色大阵光罩是不会升起的。

“就是你吗？那个朝暮山的客卿长老？”
白袍下一双眼睛灵光照射开来，如同来自九幽的凝视，那光寒彻骨，让人不寒而栗。
慕容仙儿微笑，转头看这这个白袍人，好似看着怪物一样，在她身后内院的功德殿所在，漆黑的明王雕像双眼红光初显，而广场的明宣暗暗牵动灵力，一股灵力嫁接开始。
“你这怪物，怎么想杀我不成？”慕容仙儿问道。
白袍人察觉到了明宣的动作，他一边提防着慕容仙儿，一边询问道：“阁下，我知你实力强大，但是我若拿出这个东西，不知阁下该如何应对呢？”
“暗黑摧山锤！古人兵器，现！”
冥府之主大喝，一个带着古老气息且被黑气包裹的锤子抛出。
众人震惊，此刻无论是明宣，甚至是沐战都是倒吸一口凉气，那锤子横在空中，看着如墨如煤般漆黑，但是当中散发的古老气息却是无比摄人...
“不说别的，就算你以激发霸血血拼兵王之旗也是两败俱伤，且不说胜负，我都会催动催山锤，所以你觉得你还有胜算？”
“北境之人，十王百族，千万之众，何惧生死，战！”
面对冥府之主的喝问，明宣没有畏惧，反而先发制人，一拳击退六部众，随后径直朝着沐战而去。
当明宣飞身而去时候，内院功德殿内明王雕像双眼如光大射，一道无形的灵力牵引连着明宣。
“不知死活！”
沐战刚才被慕容仙儿一掌击退显然心存不甘，但是此刻看到明宣那强弩之末的愤然袭来当下暴怒，一掌带着如同波浪翻滚的灵力涌出，两者碰触。
“噗”
各自两道身影飞射。
“杀！”
冥府之主也是大喝，随后众人又大战在一起。
残肢断臂飞起，鲜血横飞，剑阵被破，蓝衣染红鲜血，不到片刻广场被鲜血染透，院墙前一位守护左丘辰的弟子被人一刀刺穿，刀尖的鲜血连成线滴入。
带着银光，长刀袭来，在左丘辰恐惧的眼神中，有人的腰腹被刺穿，而对面之人也是被一剑斩飞头颅，那蓝色身影倒下，那双不甘的眼神，和那溢着鲜血的嘴角那么相似...

“不要，不要！为什么！”
大战瞬间再次点燃，片刻后徐老被山河印击飞，赤裸上身的男子带着嗜血般的大笑一步步朝着徐老逼近。
content_en:
The white ball of light gradually slowed down with the power of rotation. Sweat fell from Elder Nangong's cheeks, his face became even pale, and all his spiritual energy had been exhausted.
The eight living dead opened up the white ball of light without being moved, and then the six tribes also opened up the ball of spiritual power. In the anxious eyes of Mingxuan and others, the huge sickle cut through the white ball of spiritual power and was about to break open.
Elder Nangong was helpless. The spiritual formation consumed too much, and the opponent's strength was not low. With the large number of people, he could only move some low-level ones.
This can only reduce the pressure on the disciples of the academy and avoid more casualties. This is also a no-brainer...
Just when Elder Nangong was thinking this, suddenly, a jade hand with extremely pure white spiritual power poured into Nangong's back. The latter understood, and immediately urged the spiritual power to begin to fill up, and the remaining three moving formation spirit balls disappeared together.
"No, stop him!"
Mu Zhan shouted and flew down towards Murong Xianer who was behind Nangong. He only knew that this woman was the elder Keqing from Chaomu Mountain.
But Murong Xian'er had never made a move before, so Mu Zhan didn't take precautions. Furthermore, seeing how young Murong Xian'er was, he must not be very strong.
But at this moment, Murong Xianer suddenly came to help Nangong, which Mu Zhan did not expect. Nangong must not be allowed to recover at this critical moment. The fear of the formation master can influence the situation of the battle.
Turning her beautiful eyes, the girl clapped her palm with a smile. The black figure was shot away with a look of shock on her face, her eyes filled with disbelief.
But at this moment, the soldiers of the Hades Palace, the soldiers of the Mu Palace, and the men and horses of various religions all disappeared along with the white spiritual power ball.
"Young people who participated in the trial field, the time has come to test your strength. The points earned by the Xie Enforcement Hall for killing evil enemies will be included in the merit list. The disciples of the Enforcement Hall will not be included in the score list. Now it's up to you!"
With the disappearance of the moving formation, Mingxuan also threw up a small world made of water droplets and said. Apparently, thousands of people from all religions, except those in the realm of life and death, were included in the small world of the trial.
"Damn it, you ruined my good deeds."
Following Ming Xuan's words, both Mu Zhan and the Lord of Hades looked at Murong Xian'er with a solemn expression.
"Go back to the inner courtyard and don't come out!"
The cold voice came to Zuo Qiuchen's ears. It was different from the past. This time Murong Xianer's voice had a hint of coldness and murderous intent.
The scene of the white skirt fluttering and then jumping up appeared. Zuo Qiuchen was awakened, and then he ran to the inner courtyard stupidly and hid under the wall of Haitang Window.
The battlefield stopped at this moment. The grassland outside Bei'an City was eroded and withered by the black air. Black snowflakes fell from the Hades side. The huge square was devastated. Countless buildings in the outer courtyard were destroyed, including the inner courtyard.
The big blue formation rises. It is the protective formation from Beixuan College. This blue formation will not rise until it is absolutely necessary and at the moment of life and death.
"Is that you? The elder Keqing from Chaomu Mountain?"
A pair of eyes under the white robe shone with spiritual light, like a gaze from the Nine Netherworld. The light was so cold that it made people shudder.
Murong Xian'er smiled and turned to look at the man in white robes, as if looking at a monster. Behind her, in the Merit Hall in the inner courtyard, the dark eyes of the statue of King Ming began to glow red, while the brightness of the square secretly affected the spiritual power, and a spiritual power grafting began.
"You monster, why can't you kill me?" Murong Xian'er asked.
The man in white robe noticed Ming Xuan's movements. While he was wary of Murong Xian'er, he asked: "Sir, I know you are powerful, but if I take out this thing, how will you respond?"
"Dark mountain-destroying hammer! The ancient weapon appears!"
The Lord of Hades shouted, and threw a hammer with an ancient aura and wrapped in black air.
Everyone was shocked. At this moment, both Ming Xuan and even Mu Zhan took a breath of cold air. The hammer was lying in the air, looking as black as ink and coal, but the ancient aura exuding from it was...It's so stunning...
"Not to mention anything else, even if you use the tyrant blood to fight for the banner of the King of Soldiers, both sides will lose. Not to mention the outcome, I will activate the mountain hammer, so do you think you still have a chance of winning?"
"The people of the north, ten kings, hundreds of tribes, tens of millions of people, why should we fear life and death and fight!"
Facing the Lord of the Underworld's shouts, Ming Xuan was not afraid. Instead, he struck preemptively and beat back the six tribesmen with one punch, then headed straight towards Mu Zhan.
When Ming Xuan flew away, the eyes of the statue of King Ming in the Merit Hall in the inner courtyard shone like light, and an invisible spiritual force connected Ming Xuan.
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
Mu Zhan was obviously unwilling to be repelled by Murong Xian'er's palm just now, but now he saw Ming Xuan's overwhelming anger and became furious. A palm with spiritual power like rolling waves came out, and the two touched.
"Poof"
Two figures each shot out.
"Kill!"
The Lord of Hades also shouted loudly, and then everyone fought together again.
Broken limbs flew up, and blood flew everywhere. The sword array was broken, and the blue clothes were stained red with blood. Within a moment, the square was soaked with blood. A disciple guarding Zuo Qiuchen in front of the courtyard wall was pierced by a knife, and the blood dripped from the tip of the knife into a line.
With silver light, the long knife struck. In Zuo Qiuchen's fearful eyes, someone's waist and abdomen were pierced, and the person on the opposite side also had his head chopped off with a sword. The blue figure fell down, and his unwilling eyes were so similar to the corners of his mouth overflowing with blood...
"No, no! Why!"
The battle ignited again in an instant. A moment later, Mr. Xu was knocked away by the Mountain and River Seal. The shirtless man approached Mr. Xu step by step with a bloodthirsty laugh.
